brief: Fed Governor Waller turned dovish, citing signs of disinflation and signaling he would support holding rates. That pushed September hike odds from over 70% to a coin toss (Polymarket 41%). Bianco Research reads the FOMC vote as 6 hold-5 hike-1 undecided, with Powell deciding. Gains paused after ISM Services PMI showed the highest prices-paid reading since July 2022. The dollar fell over 0.6% as the yen surged on BOJ rate-hike pricing, with no confirmed intervention. Gold rose 2.5% above $4500 and bitcoin rose 5% above $81,000. Broadcom beat with a large FY27/28 AI revenue guide ($115bn/$230bn), though Q4 revenue guidance came in slightly below Street estimates. Snowflake's reaction was cleaner on accelerating product revenue. Goldman's Privorotsky says peak AI multiples were likely set in Q2, and the market now needs proof AI spending durability can outrun multiple compression, contingent on energy prices not rising. Oil pulled back from $93 after Saudi Arabia held its official crude price steady, while US diesel prices approached record highs on refining constraints. Goldman's Mueller-Glissmann calls bond markets a speed limit for equities, warning sharper yield increases could weigh more than the gradual rise seen so far.
